radiusSource: Radius 28.5 +/- 2.1 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 12204: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 28.5 +/- 2.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 19,827,450 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
